analysis_difference: Only adds source-hashed training-seen/cold-group verification; metric and bootstrap formulas unchanged
interpretation: One seed and the original fixed split. User-cluster bootstrap preserves all samples per drawn user; the primary estimand is sample mean, not equal-user mean. Intervals do not cover training-seed variation, historical model selection, or the H1-informed choice to freeze at R20. Auxiliary intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted. A-C compares the common freeze-at-R20 protocol; A-B is a practical baseline comparison with different freeze times/T clocks. Aggregate @50 is a fixed aggregation of candidate five-item lists, not one complete fifty-item list.
